neighborhoods.name: Roosevelt
neighborhoods.homes: older houses near NDSU, many rented to students

housing: Fargo's rentals are mostly apartment complexes, many in south Fargo, plus older houses near downtown and NDSU.
climate: Test the furnace, check windows and doors for drafts, and ask about plug-ins for engine block heaters and the sump pump; winters are extremely cold.
fact: Fargo sits on the Red River, which floods in spring, so ask whether the building has flooded before.
